title: Phenotyping Refractory Cardiogenic Shock Patients Receiving Venous-arterial Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation with Machine Learning Algorithms
summary: Clustering of a prospective 210-patient VA-ECMO cohort identified three cardiogenic-shock phenotypes with distinct in-hospital mortality; this exploratory result has single-center scope.
